By this petition, the petitioner seeks quashing of the Fir bearing C.R.No. 176 of
2024 registered with the Lonavala Rural Police Station, Pune, for the alleged offences
punishable under Sections 406, 420, 465, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code.
2 .  Learned APP, on instructions, states that the investigation is almost complete and Police will be filing chargesheet within two weeks from today.

sentences.text: In view of the aforesaid statement, we permit the Police to file chargesheet.
As and when chargesheet is filed, we grant leave to the petitioner to annex the chargesheet and make other consequential amendments on or before 7th November, 2025.
An advance copy of the amended petition, be served on the learned Counsel for the other- side.

SANDESH D. PATIL, J. REVATI MOHITE DERE, J.
